title: Portable install payload completeness and automated regression test
acceptance: The portable install copies every manifest-listed payload file, including install.ps1; the installed tree verifies against its own manifest; fresh, upgrade, legacy docs\\docs and in-place runs are covered by an automated script wired into cargo xtask installer-test and package.ps1 -SelfTest.
notes: Fresh review blocking B1: install.ps1 was absent from the portable payload allowlist, so every portable install failed its own manifest and the installed copy stayed at the pre-fix v0.1.0 script. Also adds the regression test RULES 5 requires.
